parts.title: Report a balanced set
parts.body: Group measures into realized value, adoption, delivery, reliability, risk, and organizational capability. Each measure needs an owner, numerator and denominator, cadence, and threshold. Pair leading signals with results; an increase in usage is useful only if quality and business outcomes hold.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Spot a false positive
parts.body: Monthly active users rose 40%, but escalations and manual corrections doubled. Write the executive explanation, investigation owner, and temporary action. A green adoption measure must not hide a red quality measure.
parts.label: Apply
